recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in a vibrant red suit standing ankle-deep in a vast, calm ocean. The composition is split horizontally by the water line, with a soft blue sky above and dark, rippling water below. Large, semi-transparent serif typography spans the horizon, partially obscured by the central figure.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the saturated red suit and the cool blue/teal environment.
Symmetry created by the central figure and the horizontal division of sky and sea.
Depth established by the figure's reflection in the foreground water ripples.
coreInvariants: Horizon line positioned at the vertical center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, medium-full shot, feet submerged.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The saturated red suit acts as the primary focal point against the muted background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red figure, moves outward along the horizontal text, then down to the reflection in the water.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and water create a sense of isolation and scale.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and muted blue (water and sky).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the subject; low to medium saturation on the environment to emphasize the figure.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones in the background
Maintain pure red for the suit

letterConstructionRules: Significant stroke weight variation between thick and thin lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and minimalism.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment with the sea-sky boundary

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant sharp serifs.
Modern digital alternative with similar weight distribution.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide shot of a man in a bright red suit standing in the middle of a calm ocean under a cloudy blue sky. The water should show gentle ripples and a reflection of the man. The horizon line should be perfectly horizontal and centered.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large uppercase serif text across the horizon line. Set the text to white with 70% opacity. Ensure the man in the red suit appears to be in front of the text.

verificationChecks: Is the suit a vibrant, saturated red?
Is the text semi-transparent and behind the man?
Is the reflection visible in the water?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos on the clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness of the reflection.
Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the color balance between the red suit and teal water.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in [Color] [Garment] standing in [Environment] with [Translucent Serif Text] spanning the [Horizon Line].
